propositions: Replace manual attempt scheduler in _pai_structured with one bounded Pydantic Agent run preserving full history and request budget across output recovery attempts.

Implement HistoryProcessor wire projection that includes failed ModelResponse on retry wire only when response tokens plus effective_max_tokens fit within model context window for all candidates, else omits response whole and raises ContextWindowExceededError on authoritative-input overflow.

Attach concision-aware guard capability to prompted TextOutput branch only (not NativeOutput), which detects truncation via finish_reason or provider_details and sends ModelRetry with concision instruction before parsing, sharing one output-retry counter.

Compute combined request_limit once as base allowance plus output-retry allowance with no per-attempt reset, pinned behaviorally to shared pydantic-ai counter so concision retry and parse retry exhaust same allowance.
NativeOutput branch preserves mode selection, bug-895c grammar fallback, terminal truncation behavior, and existing pai_output.guard_capability() without concision retry.

Return bare base req_limit from build_usage_limits for telemetry and banking inverse exactness while storing combined allowance internally in UsageLimits, verified against existing consumers completion_banking and plan_recovery_pool.
